name: Set Stabilize Network Routing
description: Blocks redirect-based routing changes for stable latency
commands:
netsh int ip set global icmpredirects=disabled
netsh int ip set global sourceroutingbehavior=drop
netsh int ipv6 set global icmpredirects=disabled
netsh int ipv6 set global sourceroutingbehavior=drop
revert22H2:
netsh int ip set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ip set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
netsh int ipv6 set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
revert23H2:
netsh int ip set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ip set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
netsh int ipv6 set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
revert24H2:
netsh int ip set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ip set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
netsh int ipv6 set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
revertCommands:
netsh int ip set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ip set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
netsh int ipv6 set global icmpredirects=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global sourceroutingbehavior=forward
